purpose: Teacher-approved recurring Portfolio visual AND wording contract. Data changes; recurring report structure/labels/prompts do not drift between runs.
fidelity_rule: The HTML templates are canonical shells, not examples. Preserve fixed text exactly except declared tokens/loops. Do not synonymize headings, reflection prompts, teacher categories, table columns, page titles, or footer purpose statements.

student_packet.page_2_subtitle: All 4 Mastery Goals and all 16 I Cans
fixed_sections: When I am ready to work on this
reflection_prompts: I found the exact MG, I Can, and family listed above.
What do I think I need to understand or practice better?
What is one question I want to ask when I work on this?
forbidden: row-by-row redundant status words when the status marker already communicates status
renaming Unit Evidence Picture to Evidence Detail
page_1_target_fields: exact MG + I Can + Bank family practice path
student_packet.page_2_i_can_row: Each I Can row shows the status marker, exact I Can text, and one compact Next: action label from student_action_states.

student_feedback_frames.current_picture: Use a short factual body-of-evidence snapshot. On an early first-source run, explicitly say that one Quick Check can provide strong first evidence but does not establish mastery by itself.
student_feedback_frames.strength: Use evidence-grounded sentences beginning with You showed... or You also...; mention the exact demonstrated skill, not internal rubric mechanics.
student_feedback_frames.family_A_note: Start with the direct Family A example. After that makes sense, the other two families stay grouped with this same I Can in the Student Bank.
student_feedback_frames.family_B_note: Use Family B for another representation or route on the same I Can. The other families stay grouped with this same I Can in the Student Bank.
student_feedback_frames.family_C_note: Use Family C for reasoning, misconception checking, or transfer on the same I Can. The other families stay grouped with this same I Can in the Student Bank.
student_feedback_frames.target_reason_rule: Use the approved page_1_why_frame from the selected student_action_state. An optional second sentence may state that mastering this I Can would make its Mastery Goal demonstrated, but only when that is factually true.
student_feedback_frames.target_next_step_rule: Use the approved page_1_next_step from the selected student_action_state. Do not replace it with a generic coaching paragraph.

teacher_summary.latest_card_body_label: Students needing stronger or additional evidence
teacher_summary.latest_card_rule: One needs-evidence list only. Do not invent separate name buckets for convincing/partial/limited/unusable on latest-source pages.
teacher_summary.period_rule: Combined page groups 3rd Hour then 6th Hour (or current period order). Individual period pages omit repeated period suffixes after names.
teacher_summary.name_format: First name + last initial; bulleted; 2 or 3 columns as fit allows; never append period after every name.
teacher_summary.longitudinal_rule: Use full evidence ledger/current status, not only newest source. Preserve current status counts, independent opportunity count, latest source/date, and Review flags.

bank_practice_link.stable_anchor_rule: Family anchor is canonical family_id; I Can and MG anchors remain canonical IDs.

NEEDS_FIRST_CHECK.when: No usable evidence exists for the I Can.
NEEDS_FIRST_CHECK.page_1_why_frame: There is not yet usable evidence for this I Can, so it is a clear missing piece in {MG_ID}.
NEEDS_FIRST_CHECK.page_1_next_step: Show this I Can on the next appropriate evidence check.

PRACTICE_AND_CHECK.when: The I Can is Developing and the current body of evidence does not yet contain one convincing independent demonstration, or the newest usable evidence shows a clear gap that should be repaired before another independent check.
PRACTICE_AND_CHECK.page_1_why_frame: Your current evidence shows a gap or incomplete understanding here, so this I Can should be practiced and checked again soon.
PRACTICE_AND_CHECK.page_1_next_step: Practice this I Can, then show it again on another check.

NEEDS_ANOTHER_DEMONSTRATION.when: The I Can is Developing and already has one convincing independent demonstration but has not yet met the normal Mastered rule.
NEEDS_ANOTHER_DEMONSTRATION.page_1_why_frame: You already showed this I Can convincingly once; Mastered normally needs another independent convincing demonstration.
NEEDS_ANOTHER_DEMONSTRATION.page_1_next_step: Show this I Can again on another independent check.

SECURE.page_1_why_frame: This I Can is already secure and is not normally selected as the next routine target.
SECURE.page_1_next_step: Keep using this skill as needed while you work on the next target.

EXTENSION.when: The I Can is Transfer, or routine nearby targets are secure and the selected next move is legitimate transfer/extension.
EXTENSION.page_1_why_frame: Your nearby routine targets are secure, so the next useful step is transfer or extension.
EXTENSION.page_1_next_step: Use this I Can in a less-routine or connected situation.

student_action_rule: Status and next action are separate. Use only the declared student_action_states labels/frames. Page 1 must explain WHY the selected target is next and WHAT happens next. Page 2 must show the compact action label for every I Can. Do not invent alternate action vocabulary.
